title: Origin story: Mami Wata
description: Mami Wata is the water spirit venerated across West, Central, and Southern Africa and the diaspora — beautiful, powerful, dwelling where fresh and salt water meet. She brings wealth and healing to her devotees and ruin to the faithless, embodying water's double nature.

title: Ability profile: Mami Wata
description: Ranked abilities: Beauty — rank 100/100; Water command — rank 98/100; Wealth-granting — rank 95/100; Healing — rank 93/100; Judgment — rank 92/100.

title: Power ranking: Mami Wata
description: Powers: The meeting of waters as her throne; The serpent entwined about her; Wealth and ruin in either hand.

title: Stamina feats: Mami Wata
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Worshipped across a continent for centuries; Flows wherever waters meet.

title: Crossover notes: Mami Wata
description: Mami Wata crosses naturally with: water, beauty, wealth, healing, the in-between.

title: Cultural impact: Mami Wata
description: The African mermaid; water's beauty and danger in one.

title: Generator record: Mami Wata
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Mami Wata's database.
